name: 梦幻西游2002版
english_description: A GitHub mirror of the same 2002-era "Qingdao Station" mhxy release already preserved in this project as mhxyqd -- confirmed byte-identical across all 14,563 files (including runtime state like adm/etc/wizlist), so no separate build was produced; see mhxyqd for the live, playable instance and its full fix catalog.
